# Lab 26.2: dbt with BigQuery

## What We Are Going to Do
Set up dbt Core with the BigQuery adapter in Cloud Shell, build models, and run tests.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Install dbt and create a project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">pip install --quiet dbt-bigquery
dbt --version
dbt init thelook_dbt --skip-profile-setup
cd thelook_dbt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Create the connection profile.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">mkdir -p ~/.dbt
cat &gt; ~/.dbt/profiles.yml &lt;&lt;EOF
thelook_dbt:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: bigquery
      method: oauth
      project: $PROJECT_ID
      dataset: lab26_dbt
      location: US
      threads: 4
EOF
dbt debug</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Write a source, a staging model and a mart.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">rm -rf models/example
mkdir -p models/staging models/marts
cat &gt; models/staging/sources.yml &lt;&lt;'EOF'
version: 2
sources:
  - name: thelook
    database: bigquery-public-data
    schema: thelook_ecommerce
    tables: [{name: orders}, {name: users}]
EOF
cat &gt; models/staging/stg_orders.sql &lt;&lt;'EOF'
SELECT order_id, user_id, LOWER(status) AS status, created_at
FROM {{ source('thelook', 'orders') }}
EOF
cat &gt; models/marts/orders_by_country.sql &lt;&lt;'EOF'
{{ config(materialized='table', partition_by={'field': 'order_month', 'data_type': 'date'}) }}
SELECT u.country, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(o.created_at), MONTH) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM {{ ref('stg_orders') }} o JOIN {{ source('thelook', 'users') }} u ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
EOF
cat &gt; models/staging/schema.yml &lt;&lt;'EOF'
version: 2
models:
  - name: stg_orders
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: status
        tests:
          - accepted_values: {values: ['complete','shipped','processing','returned','cancelled']}
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

5. **[Console] See the output.** Open `lab26_dbt` in BigQuery: `stg_orders` (view) and `orders_by_country` (partitioned table). In **Personal history**, each dbt step is a job.

6. **Compare with Dataform (Module 8).** Both build SQL models with dependencies and tests. Dataform is built into BigQuery; dbt is a separate open-source tool with a large community.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Adapter | `dbt-bigquery` with OAuth |
| Models | View + partitioned table |
| Tests | unique, not_null, accepted_values |
| Choice | Dataform (built-in) or dbt (open source) |
